Privacy (https://uncloseai.com/privacy-policy.html and https://uncloseai.com/terms-of-use.html, both last updated 2026-10-18, read 2026-11-24): IP addresses and request metadata are kept in access logs for up to one year; traffic, including prompts, is subject to automated scanning and random sampling, and captured content is kept as long as needed to act on abuse and may be disclosed when required by law or to report abuse; no training use is stated; operated from the United States with no named legal entity.
hobby-grade: audit §5.1 records no availability guarantee, and the ToU's one real constraint is not degrading service — a host must rate-limit conservatively
the ToU prohibits developing "competing machine learning services without attribution", which is a term a host embedding this provider should read before shipping

toolCalling.sourceRef: https://uncloseai.com/inference.html (read 2026-11-24): the current vLLM launch command has neither --enable-auto-tool-choice nor --tool-call-parser ("Off on purpose: ... the INT4-era --tool-call-parser: this entry passes no extra arguments"); only the retired Hermes-3 command set --tool-call-parser hermes. vLLM (https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/tool_calling.html, read 2026-11-24): --enable-auto-tool-choice is what lets the model "generate its own tool calls", and without a loaded parser a required or named tool_choice returns HTTP 400. Whether an auto tool request returns tool_calls is unproven (live-call list).
